scripts.validate: cd server && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../client && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.verify: npm run check:i18n && npm run check:css && npm run check:secrets && npm run verify:deps && npm run verify:server && npm run verify:client && npm run verify:e2e
scripts.verify:deps: cd server && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate && npm audit --audit-level=high && cd ../client && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate && npm audit --audit-level=high
scripts.verify:docker: docker build -t lume-server:local server && docker build -t lume-client:local client
scripts.verify:server: cd server && npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test:coverage && npm run build
scripts.verify:client: cd client && npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run test:coverage && npm run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
